$comment: Lane B of the PhoneUse-derived work: verified field input and compact whole-screen observations. What was built, how it was tested, what it does not cover. All evidence is from offline fixtures, a loopback WebDriverAgent double and isolated temporary homes with every device helper trapped; no phone, Pixel, MacBook or iPhone was contacted.

commits.implementation: the commit that adds this file (HEAD of the branch)

upstream_reference.copied_source: none; Tomacco-native implementations of the reviewed patterns, no upstream code, installers, tests or scripts run

verified_fill.contract: fill with verify_value:true in runtime.input and in runtime.actions fill steps. Opt-in: a plain fill (no verify_value) is unchanged, byte-identical results on the fixture against the base binary.
steps: tap the step's x, y once

wait up to focus_timeout_ms (default 2000, max 10000, never beyond the batch deadline) for the active element; identity = it covers the tapped point (2 pt slack) or, with field_name, its accessibility identifier or label equals field_name
refuse unread: XCUIElementTypeSecureTextField (secure_field), anything but TextField/SearchField/TextView (not_a_text_editor), disabled
read the value on the same session and element ID; a value equal to placeholderValue is 'placeholder', never entered text
already exactly the text (not via placeholder): verified, writes [] (no clear, no write)
otherwise clear (skipped when unambiguously empty) and write once; empty text clears only
read back on the same element ID, polling up to 1 s for an exact (code point) match
submit:true: one Return (/wda/keys \n) only after verified/already_matching and only while the same element still has the focus

outcomes.verified: result verified:true, field_status verified|already_matching, writes [{op,outcome}], editor {element,class,name,label,rect,placeholder:bool}, before {state,chars}, value {chars,match:exact,shows_placeholder}, submitted, focus_polls, evidence wda|fixture
outcomes.uncertain_after_a_write: field_uncertain with details.reason clear_unknown|write_unknown|partial_write|field_replaced|readback_unavailable|value_matches_placeholder|value_mismatch|submit_unknown, details.writes and retried:false; nothing is ever retyped
outcomes.submit_not_sent: field_submit_not_sent: value verified, focus moved or Return could not be sent
outcomes.transport_without_support: fill_verification_unsupported, nothing sent (not even the tap)

verified_fill.runtime_actions: a verified fill step is status verified; field_uncertain makes it status uncertain, listed in the new uncertain_steps (not in applied_steps), batch stops, remedy says never resend; field_* codes are kept rather than folded into actions_step_failed; an expect postcondition after a submit is checked separately and its failure does not repeat the step
verified_fill.delivery_evidence: native/runtime/iphone.rs WebDriverAgent HTTP errors now carry details.delivery: not_sent (connect/handshake/request build), answered (HTTP status with WDA JSON, as before plus the key) or unknown (request sent, reply lost, timed out, truncated or not JSON). Additive to existing error details.
verified_fill.capability: runtime.state and runtime.observe input_capabilities.fill_verification: {supported:true, evidence:wda, editors} on the USB iPhone, {supported:true, evidence:fixture} on a fixture scenario that scripts fields, {supported:false, reason} on every other transport (Android, Apple Simulator, AirPlay, fixture without fields) via the Device trait default

coverage.usb_iphone_wda: implemented; contract-tested against a loopback WebDriverAgent double (W3C routes, no such element, stale element reference, placeholder-as-value, dropped connection). Not run on hardware.
coverage.fixture_runtime: scripted editors (accept, lose_reply, refuse, drop_last, replace faults, delayed focus, focused_element) for end-to-end CLI/MCP/runtime.actions tests
coverage.android_simulator_airplay: unsupported, advertised; no verification is faked

not_covered: No physical iPhone run: WebDriverAgent's real attribute names (type, name, label, placeholderValue, enabled, value) and rect are taken from its W3C/XCUITest routes as the existing code already used them; the double encodes that assumption.
Autocorrect, smart punctuation, input formatters and IME composition change the read-back: reported as field_uncertain value_mismatch, by design, never retyped.
Unicode equality is exact code points; a field that normalizes (NFC/NFD) reads back as a mismatch.
Web content editors that WDA reports as XCUIElementTypeOther are not_a_text_editor.
Not a lease or ledger: does not prevent another client typing concurrently, and does not make execution exactly-once; a lost reply is reported uncertain and left to the caller.

compact_tree.contract: screen.tree mode: tree (default, unchanged), compact, detail; new arguments query (compact), refs (detail), digest (any mode). Every mode answers digest (first 16 hex digits of the hierarchy XML's SHA-256) and mode; a given digest that differs answers tree_stale before marks are replaced or anything else is done.
selection: records = shown nodes (text/description, interactive or scrollable, with area) minus folded labels; only_interactive keeps controls, numbered marks and scroll regions

tier 0: focused, editable, query match (case-insensitive tokens and whole query in text, description, resource id, folded label); tier 1: enabled controls, stateful (checkable/selected) and scroll regions/collections; tier 2: disabled controls and static text; tier 3: wholly outside the window (window = top-level nodes' bounds)
within a tier the fourth and later sibling of one class under one parent comes after the rest; the window's four horizontal bands take turns; document order within a band

greedy whole records within max_chars minus header and a reserved footer; a record that does not fit is omitted whole, a shorter one may use the room; off-screen records only when every on-screen record fitted
output in document order, indented by record depth (max 12), header 'screen WxH package P mode compact digest D', footer with omitted counts
compact_tree.records: nN reference (node index in the parsed hierarchy), short class, text, desc=, label="..." from=nA,nB for folded texts, id=, #mark (same numbering as tree/marks, stored for screen.tap), (l,t,r,b), flags checked/unchecked/selected/focused/disabled/scrollable/password/editable/offscreen/cut, in=nP:"..." only for labels shared by several records. Password text is never printed (compact) and is null with text_withheld in detail.
compact_tree.folding: a static leaf text (no shown descendants, not interactive, not a container, not a password) folds into its nearest interactive ancestor only if no scroll region/collection lies between, the ancestor is not an editor, holds no other control/editor/scroll region, contains the text's bounds, and has at most four such texts. The ancestor's own text/description/id are unchanged; detail lists label_sources and folded_into.
compact_tree.detail: complete record per ref: every attribute, has_area, mark, label, parent, children (50) and children_total, label_sources, folded_into; text/description up to 4000 characters with *_cut and *_chars when longer
compact_tree.budget: Unicode code points (chars), as tree mode; result also reports bytes
compact_tree.compatibility: base binary 3993523 vs branch binary on the same fixture: default screen.tree text and counts at max_chars 500/1500/6000/100000 with and without only_interactive, screen.marks, plain fill result and pre-existing input_capabilities keys all identical (.scratch comparison, not committed). New result keys mode and digest are additive.

fixture_measurement.$comment: Equal offline fixtures through both modes at equal budgets. Fixture data only: not a token count, not a model success rate, not device performance.

cli_fixture_360x800.source: tests/python/test_agent_observation.py through tomaccoctl call screen.tree on a fixture session

fixture_measurement.reading: On this adversarial screen (long header first) the document-order tree keeps no control at 1500 and 3000 characters; compact keeps the search field, Pay now and most controls. Compact records are longer per line, so when the whole tree fits (6000 here) compact is about 7-10% longer and on the larger fixture omits the one control below the window. No reduction in tokens is claimed.

overlap_with_lane_a: native/runtime.rs: `pub mod field;`, two default methods on trait Device (verified_fill, fill_verification), free functions advertised() and deliver(); in the worker's command loop the "input" branch calls deliver(device.as_mut(), &a) instead of device.input(&a), and both input_capabilities sites call advertised(). Lane A's dispatch enforcement (leases/request IDs) should wrap deliver() the same way it wraps device.input().

native/runtime/actions.rs: check() also validates fill-only arguments; run_step passes verify_value/field_name/submit/focus_timeout_ms for verified fills; step status verified|uncertain; stopped() adds uncertain_steps; the kept error-code list gains the field_* codes and fill_verification_unsupported. A durable ledger should record status uncertain as an unknown outcome, never as applied.
